description: This Java class 'StoreFilter' is a web application component acting as a request interceptor. It handles the initialization of store, customer, language, and content data before processing each request. The class manages session attributes, caching of content and configuration data, and builds breadcrumbs for navigation.

classes.name: StoreFilter
classes.description: A request interceptor that initializes store, customer, language, content, configuration, breadcrumbs, and session attributes for incoming web requests in an e-commerce application.

methods.name: preHandle
methods.description: Main method intercepting HTTP requests to initialize session data, cache content, and set request attributes before controller processing.

methods.name: getMerchantConfigurations
methods.description: Fetches and caches merchant-specific configurations and sets them as request attributes.

methods.name: getContentPageNames
methods.description: Retrieves content page names (CMS links) for the store and language, with caching.

methods.name: getContentObjects
methods.description: Retrieves content objects (boxes, sections) for the store and language, with caching.

methods.name: getTopCategories
methods.description: Retrieves top categories for the store and language, with caching.

methods.name: getConfigurations
methods.description: Fetches merchant configuration list from the database.

methods.name: setBreadcrumb
methods.description: Builds the breadcrumb navigation trail for the current request context.

methods.name: getDefaultBreadcrumbItem
methods.description: Creates a default breadcrumb item for the home page.

methods.name: setMerchantStoreInSession
methods.description: Sets the MerchantStore object in session by store code.
